en.name: Samwise
en.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a player (not yourself): the first time they die, they don't.

en.flavor: I made a promise, Mr. Frodo. A promise. 'Don’t you leave him, Samwise Gamgee'. And I don’t mean to. I don’t mean to.
